messages.subject: formatDistData(), The distances must be numeric
parts:
Hi, I am new to unmarked and not 100% confident on r, however, I am wanting to find some density estimates on a population of squirrels.

I am trying to use the formatDistData() function, however, when ever I run the code, I get an error saying "The distances must be numeric".
I am running the code;

> yDat <- formatDistData(Detects1, distCol="distance", transectNameCol="transect", dist.breaks=db)  - which brings up the following error -
Error in formatDistData(Detects1, distCol = "distance", transectNameCol = "transect",  : 
  The distances must be numeric

I have run the code is.numeric(Detects1$distance) which brings up TRUE. 

I am a little confused why the code will not work, and why I keep getting the error when my distances are numeric. 

If anyone could help this would be very much appreciated. Also if you need anymore information then I will try my best to provide it 

Thank you very much.
Kind regards,
Jamie
